title: Q-YEARFAIL-workflow: land the weekly yearfail workflow (protected path)
body:
**Owner:** operations
**Trigger:** every checks run (probe)
**Done check:** file:.github/workflows/yearfail.yml
**Status:** closed

YEARFAIL-1: the weekly run is the file `doctrine/protected/yearfail.workflow.yml`, to be installed as `.github/workflows/yearfail.yml`. A model branch cannot edit workflows (worker-gate deny list: claude/* and agent/* are refused, never bypassed), so this is a Protected-change: the reason is that the simulated year must run on a clock with no person. Until it lands the loop runs on demand and the clock is not declared.

**Disposition:** shelved (ttl, 2026-11-21T18:31:14Z, DISPOSE-1)

**Evidence:** open 6.0 hours (limit 6 hours) and no loop closed it (SLA-8H-1). Its closing probe still runs on every fleet pass and records `fixed` when it passes; the executor retries it when its open queue is empty (every 30 days at most).
